NO room-rate table obtained: the hotel pages on hptdc.in carry no tariffs, and the booking portal (hptdchotelbooking.hp.gov.in) and hptdc.hp.gov.in do not resolve from here. corporation_status.GMVN (Uttarakhand, Garhwal): NOT OBTAINED. gmvnonline.com returns HTTP 403 to every request here (curl and WebFetch); not bypassed. Wayback snapshots of room-tariff pages hold no rate table (it loads by script). corporation_status.JKTDC (J&K): NO TARIFF CARD. jktdc.co.in shows only per-date prices from a booking form (no season/off-season table, empty Download Section). Not queried date by date.
corporation_status.UPSTDC (Uttar Pradesh): NO TARIFF CARD on upstdc.co.in; rates only appear per date inside the booking engine.
corporation_status.Haryana Tourism: Citizen charter PDF (haryanatourism.gov.in, 2024 upload) prints ONE EP tariff per room 'as on 10.7.2020' (e.g. Badkhal Deluxe 2399, Standard 1999). No season/off-season split except hall/lawn charges. Nothing recorded.
corporation_status.DTTDC (Delhi): No hotel tariff card; citizen charter covers buses, packages and B&B scheme only.
corporation_status.Punjab Tourism: Site did not resolve from here (punjabtourism.gov.in); not checked further.
corporation_status.Ladakh: ladakh.gov.in loads but has no tariff card; Leh hotels found publish a single summer card only (Hotel Choskor: one card valid 15 Apr-30 Oct 2025, no winter card), so no pair recorded.
corporation_status.Private hotels: 15 rows from hotels' own tariff pages: Manali 6, Mussoorie 2, Shimla/Kufri 4, Nainital 2, McLeod Ganj 1. notes:
HOW TO READ. kmvn rows: headline_room is a double-occupancy room present in all three season tables with the SAME meal plan (EP/CP/MAP differs by property, flagged per room); rates are ex-GST (5 percent on most rooms). main_season / autumn_season / off_season are KMVN's own three column names. Private/other rows: season_rate_inr and off_season_rate_inr are the same room and meal plan; tax_basis says whether GST is in or out.

KMVN CALENDAR (the key finding). For 2026-27 the KMVN hill-station TRHs (Ranikhet, Mohaan, Kausani, Abbott Mount, Ramgarh, Sattal, Mukteshwar, Chaukori, Munsyari, Naukuchiatal, Bhimtal, Bhowali, Nainital Sukhatal/Tallital; 16 properties) assign only TWO bands: Main Season = 31 Mar-29 Jun and 21 Dec-9 Jan; Autumn Season = 30 Jun-20 Dec and 10 Jan-30 Mar (so Oct and Nov are the mid tier, NOT the top tier; the Main bands are summer and the Christmas-New Year window). The Off Season tariff column still exists, but its last dated period ends 26 Mar 2025, so it is not applied to any 2026-27 date on the site calendar. Median over 28 properties: off/main 0.70, autumn/main 0.82 (same medians for the 16-hill-station subset). Properties with a flat single rate (Pithoragarh area, Dharchula etc.) show Main only or Main with no date split. Some remote TRHs (Dharchula, Katarmal, Snowview, Chaukori) have bespoke date lists; their printed chips are in main_season_periods_from_2026_04 / autumn_season_periods_from_2026_04. Earlier years (2023-25) used weekday/weekend chips for Autumn vs Off Season, visible in the raw endpoint output.

HPTDC. Only season definitions retrieved (see corporation_status). Season = 1 Apr-30 Jun, 15 Sep-15 Nov, 23 Dec-2 Jan; Leisure = 1 Jul-14 Sep, 16 Nov-22 Dec, 3 Jan-31 Mar. That makes June peak and also puts mid-Sep to mid-Nov in season.

PRIVATE HOTELS. Manali (6 hotels): every card puts peak = mid/15 Apr to 30 Jun or 15 Jul plus mid-Dec to 5-10 Jan; off = rest. Manali June is PEAK on all 5 current cards (the ledger calls it low season). Manali off/season ratios on the headline room: 0.40-0.71 (median 0.50); the ledger's peak=1.35x, low=0.65x implies low/peak = 0.48, so the SIZE of the swing is about right for Manali but the MONTHS are wrong (all 5 undated-but-current Manali cards run season from mid-April to 30 Jun-15 Jul, plus mid-Dec to early Jan). Mussoorie Gateway puts Aug-Mar at a flat LOW tier (incl Dec-Jan; peak only on holidays/long weekends/Christmas week), Calux Hill Queen uses Manali-style dates (15 Apr-15 Jul + 20 Dec-5 Jan). Shimla cards: Fairmount and Snow Valley Shimla 2026-27 start season at 1 Apr / 23 Apr and end it 5-15 Jul; Willow Banks adds 1 Oct-15 Nov as Autumn season. Nainital: Green Leaf season = 15 May-2 Jul only, mid 1 Apr-14 May, off 3 Jul-23 Dec + 2 Jan-31 Mar (off/season 0.61 EP); stale 2019 Hotel Himalaya card shows Oct as MID and mid-May to Jun as HIGH. 'Stale' rows (2018-19) are kept for date pattern only and excluded from the ratio.

MEDIANS: KMVN off/main 0.70 (n=28 properties, one room each); private hotels off/season 0.59 (n=12 current cards, range 0.40-0.81; the two stale rows 0.54 and 0.64 are excluded; Flourishing Flora excluded as it is not a true low-season card); all 40 together 0.70.

CAVEATS. KMVN rates are MAP/CP/EP depending on the property (compare within a property only). KMVN Main vs Autumn ratio 0.82 means the dated KMVN calendar swings far less than the private hotels' 0.4-0.6. Two JMR/Snow Valley cards include GST while others quote ex-GST; ratios are unaffected. No rate was taken from memory; every number here was read from the URL in its row on 2026-10-10. Aggregator figures (allseasonsz, euttaranchal, ashextourism) were seen in search results and deliberately not used.
